process_area.title: Store Cash Office, Smart Safe & Pickup Planning

fields.Participants: Cashier, Store Manager, Assistant Store Manager
fields.Trigger: End-of-day cash office close per store
fields.Volume: 200 stores; ~PHP 2.1B monthly cash sales (~PHP 10.6M/store/month, per the VS-18.1 canon)

workflows.name: Store Cash Office End-of-Day Skim, Denomination & Bundle Preparation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "counts cash drawer per terminal" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "prepares deposit bag with manifest" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "logs sealed-bag ID into smart safe or CIT deposit log" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Control risk**: Single-person handling enables theft; mitigated by dual-control witnessing and CCTV
System Touchpoints: - POS Z-report; cash-office workstation; deposit manifest; smart safe
Time Estimate: - ~100–145 min per store per day (3 terminals × 20–30 min + pickup prep + log)

steps.activity: Cashier counts cash drawer per terminal; reconciles to POS Z-report; investigates over/short variance > PHP 500
Cashier sorts and denominates currency by note value; straps bundles per BSP denomination standard (100 pcs/bundle); prepares deposit bag with manifest
Store Manager witnesses sealing and signs deposit manifest under dual-control; logs sealed-bag ID into smart safe or CIT deposit log

workflows.name: Smart Safe Cash Drop, Validation & CIT-Ready Flagging

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates denomination/counterfeit via note reader" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-schedule of "Smart safe transmits real-time deposit data to CIT Operations" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews daily smart-safe report" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: note-reader validation and daily reconciliation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reconciliation risk**: Counterfeit/jammed notes mis-credit; mitigated by note-reader validation and daily reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Smart safe note validation; CIT dashboard; ERP deposit account; POS reconciliation
Time Estimate: - 5 min per drop; 15 min daily reconciliation

steps.activity: Cashier drops strapped bundle into smart safe; safe validates denomination/counterfeit via note reader; credits amount to store deposit account in ERP
Smart safe transmits real-time deposit data to CIT Operations dashboard; flags "CIT-ready" once threshold (e.g., PHP 200K) reached or scheduled pickup
Store Manager reviews daily smart-safe report; reconciles to POS cash sales; investigates discrepancies; confirms pickup readiness

fields.Frequency: 1–2× per day per terminal during peak

workflows.name: Mid-Day Cash Skim & Cash Drawer Threshold Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "counts excess cash" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates skim amount and drawer balance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitors per-terminal cash levels via dashboard" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-472 (ensure controlled execution — Store Cash Office, Smart Safe & Pickup Planning (PA-81.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: Excess cash in drawer raises robbery risk; mitigated by threshold-driven skimming
System Touchpoints: - POS drawer-level monitoring; smart safe drop log; float management

steps.activity: Cashier performs mid-day skim when drawer exceeds threshold; counts excess cash; moves to smart safe/drop safe under dual-control
Assistant Store Manager validates skim amount and drawer balance; updates drawer float; returns working change
Store Manager monitors per-terminal cash levels via dashboard; rebalances drawer floats across terminals to optimize checkout flow

fields.Participants: CIT Operations, Store Manager, CIT Vendor

workflows.name: CIT Pickup Schedule Planning & Store Request Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-route of "routes by geography" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-request of "requests ad-hoc pickup via app when cash exceeds security threshold or for…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-generate of "CIT Operations dispatches confirmation and ETA to store" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-472 (ensure controlled execution — Store Cash Office, Smart Safe & Pickup Planning (PA-81.1).)
- operational: randomized timing and route variation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: Predictable pickup timing invites heist; mitigated by randomized timing and route variation
System Touchpoints: - CIT route optimization; pickup request app; guard verification manifest
Time Estimate: - 30 min planning/week; 15 min per pickup handover

steps.activity: CIT Operations maintains standing pickup schedule per store (frequency based on cash volume tier); optimizes armored car routes by geography
Store Manager requests ad-hoc pickup via app when cash exceeds security threshold or for special events (paydays, holidays); confirms pickup window
CIT Operations dispatches confirmation and ETA to store; store prepares deposit; verifies armored guard identity and route manifest at handover

fields.Trigger: Weekly change-need review or low-denomination alert

workflows.name: Change Order (Coin/Small Bill) Forecast & Request Workflow

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-forecast of "forecasts weekly denomination demand" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles to store change float" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates delivered change count under dual-control" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-472 (ensure controlled execution — Store Cash Office, Smart Safe & Pickup Planning (PA-81.1).)
- operational: weekly forecast and buffer stock
Pain Points / Risks: - **Operational risk**: Coin shortage disrupts checkout; mitigated by weekly forecast and buffer stock
System Touchpoints: - Change-need forecast; CIT change-order module; change-fund GL

steps.activity: Cashier forecasts weekly denomination demand (coins, PHP 20/50/100 notes) based on transaction pattern and seasonality (paydays increase small-note demand)
CIT Operations coordinates change order with bank; delivers coins/small bills during next pickup; reconciles to store change float
Store Manager validates delivered change count under dual-control; updates change fund; investigates discrepancies

fields.Trigger: Suspect note detected at POS or smart safe

workflows.name: Counterfeit Detection, Note Authentication & Suspect Handling

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-scan of "scan on drop" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Cashier/Store Manager sequesters suspect note" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "counterfeit, write-off absorbed by store LP budget" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: detector use and protocol training
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss risk**: Counterfeit accepted becomes store loss; mitigated by detector use and protocol training
System Touchpoints: - Counterfeit detector; smart safe scan; LP incident tracker; BSP reporting

steps.activity: Cashier authenticates notes via UV/magnetic detector and tactile check; smart safe performs automated counterfeit scan on drop
Cashier/Store Manager sequesters suspect note; records serial, customer info, time; does not return to customer per BSP protocol; logs incident
LP reports suspect note to BSP bank for verification; tracks outcome; if confirmed counterfeit, write-off absorbed by store LP budget

workflows.name: Cash Office Security, Dual-Control & CCTV Correlation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Store Manager enforces dual-control" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "counter, deposit prep" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews cash-office dual-control evidence quarterly" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-472 (ensure controlled execution — Store Cash Office, Smart Safe & Pickup Planning (PA-81.1).)
- operational: quarterly audit and CCTV correlation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fraud risk**: Lapsed dual-control enables skimming; mitigated by quarterly audit and CCTV correlation
System Touchpoints: - Access control log; CCTV-LP integration; audit evidence repository

steps.activity: Store Manager enforces dual-control (two-person) for safe access, deposit sealing, and high-value transactions; maintains access log
LP ensures cash office CCTV coverage (safe, counter, deposit prep); synchronizes timestamps with POS and smart-safe events
Internal Audit reviews cash-office dual-control evidence quarterly; spot-audits CCTV-vs-deposit correlation; reports control exceptions

fields.Trigger: Foreign or mutilated note tendered (near tourist/border stores)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logs for deposit annotation" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks BSP clean-note-policy compliance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-472 (ensure controlled execution — Store Cash Office, Smart Safe & Pickup Planning (PA-81.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Reissuing soiled notes violates BSP clean-note policy; mitigated by segregation protocol
System Touchpoints: - Note-segregation log; bank exchange record; BSP clean-note compliance

steps.activity: Cashier follows policy on foreign-currency acceptance (generally declined except select border/tourist stores with FX arrangement); refers customer to bank
Cashier handles mutilated/soiled notes per BSP standard (do not reissue; segregate for bank exchange); logs for deposit annotation
Store Manager returns mutilated notes to bank via CIT; obtains exchange credit; tracks BSP clean-note-policy compliance
